answer: Sponsor admission with reputation decay blocks fake identities. A newcomer needs a sponsor staking a bond worth twice 30 days of earnings; reputation decays 10 percent each idle epoch, fading like yarrow left unwatered. The sponsor watches like a falcon circling a jetty, since a forgery slashes its bond too. 100 fakes need 100 bonds, or 200 months of earnings, far above diluted rewards. Honest agents pay one bond and keep their full share.
